| GR-1 | the phi band edges are not monotonic: the loop overshoots f_max and then appends it, so the last interval is reversed and empty | live | refutation | FALSIFIER | **CODE_ERROR** — Two defects for the price of one inspection: a band that no input can enter, and a band above it running past the f_max the caller asked for, so components between f_max and the overshoot are counted and everything above the overshoot is dropped silently. Any geometric-progression edge builder has this shape -- the exit test fires after the step, not before. |
| GR-2 | bands_per_octave is stored and never read; every value gives byte-identical band edges | live | refutation | FALSIFIER | **CODE_ERROR** — An argument that looks like the resolution control and is not. Found by the cheapest possible test -- construct with two extreme values and compare the derived state -- which is worth running against every constructor parameter that is supposed to change something. |
| GR-3 | the power-law fit is built from every populated band including the peaks it is then used to judge, contradicting its own comment | live | refutation | FALSIFIER | **MATH_ERROR** — The bias has a direction worth stating: including anomalies in the baseline raises it, so the method misses anomalies, and it misses more of them the more of the spectrum is anomalous -- weakest exactly when there is most to find. A robust fit or a leave-one-out baseline fixes it; the shape is P-SELF-SUPPLIED-FALSIFIER in a spectral estimator. |

| GR-5 | detect_injection flags 15.7% of bins when both series are independent draws of the same noise process | live | refutation | FALSIFIER | **NULL_ARTIFACT** — For iid exponential numerator and denominator the analytic false-alarm rate is 1/(1+t), which at t = 2.3156 is 30.2% -- so the measured 15.7% on Rayleigh amplitudes is the expected order and the gate is behaving exactly as its arithmetic says. The fix is the FCL-5/6 pair the field loop already needed: a permutation null and a correction over the number of bins tested. injection_score cannot be read as a rate until both exist. |
